description: Returns the full detail of a job listing published on Level, by its UUID, its slug (e.g. "senior-ml-engineer-acme-corp") or the listing's page URL. Includes recently expired listings, like the public page (`status` is then "expired"); a listing closed for more than 30 days returns `status: "expired"` with similar open listings, not an error. Never returns a direct link to the employer's ATS: use the returned `url` (the canonical jobsbylevel.com page) to apply.

id_or_slug.description: The listing's UUID, slug or page URL.

name: get_job
title: Get a Level job listing
